title: Bryan Johnson on perfect sleep, olive oil, measuring everything and Don't Die
summary: Bryan explains why sleep is the top daily priority, how he reached six months of 100% sleep scores, and why extra virgin olive oil is a near-top easy habit. He also covers measuring biomarkers (speed of aging, NAD, nighttime erections), gene therapy and the Don't Die case, with Kate describing 90 days on Blueprint.

principles.text: Sleep is the single most important thing you do each day; sleep deprivation impairs judgment like intoxication.
principles.quote: sleep is the single most important thing any human does on any given day

principles.text: Prioritizing sleep means arranging life around it, even against social norms.
principles.quote: it forces you to make really hard decisions on your actual lifestyle which it does it pits you against social norms

principles.text: Extra virgin olive oil is one of the easiest high-impact habits, but only if it meets quality thresholds.
principles.quote: extra verion olive oil is very close to number one

principles.text: Measure before trusting any intervention; NAD needs sustained levels (oral NMN/NR), not drips.
principles.quote: you want sustained levels of NAD

principles.text: Know your weight, your speed of aging, and your nighttime erection duration as baseline health indicators.
principles.quote: you know how much you weigh how fast you're aging and the duration of your nighttime erections

principles.text: Diet, sleep and exercise are largely mastered; going further means more powerful therapies like gene therapy.
principles.quote: you can only do so much with diet sleep and exercise and we've kind of mastered those things
